filo get FILE... --FIELD... [-0]

  Prints fields of each file from the register, for scripts and quick checks, in
  the order the fields are given. One field of one file prints its bare value;
  several fields of one file print a name and value per line; several files
  print a row each, the values in order and the file last. A field with no value
  prints as empty. Nothing is changed, and nothing is read from the disk.

  Piped, values are separated by tabs and the file is its absolute path, last,
  so a name holding a tab still splits right; -0 ends each row with a NUL
  instead of a newline and writes names exactly, for xargs -0 and tar --null.

Flags
  --file-date              the date a period counts from (YYYY-MM-DD)
  --retention              as typed (7y, forever, a date) or a policy's name
  --keep-until             the date it is kept until, or forever
  --status                 kept, forever, expired, changed, undated,
                           needs_file_date, possible_move, unreadable; missing
                           or deleted for a file not present
  --duplicates             the content's decision: always, records or counted
  --size                   in bytes
  --modified               its modification time, RFC 3339, local time
  --sha256                 its content's hash, as sha256sum prints it
  --root                   the root it is in
  --first-seen             the date filo first saw it
  -0                       end rows with NUL, names unescaped (for a pipe only)
